fim.note: The generation budget is sized per symbol (estimated tokens of the symbol being replaced x num_predict_headroom, clamped to [min,max]) rather than fixed. A fixed 256 was used in the first 1-ticket smoke run (2026-09-12) and truncated every sample mid-statement on an 80-line/~825-token target, scoring 0/3 -- see utils.patch_generation.resolve_num_predict.

sampling.note: One FIM sample is generated per listed temperature (sampling_index == its position in this list), so n == len(temperatures). Extend this list to raise n; do not change it mid-run once a stage's results are being compared.

symbol_selection.note: Only the top-ranked stage3_ranked_symbols[*] candidate per ticket is attempted by default -- this mirrors what a real system would act on. Pass --symbol-topk on the CLI to attempt more of the ranked list per ticket (multiplies FIM call volume linearly).

eligibility.definition: A ticket is conditional-eligible iff stage3_ranked_symbols is non-empty (i.e. symbol_gate_status != block_no_symbol_candidate for that ticket). This is the same 'conditional' definition Stage-3 WP4's recall metric uses, so Stage-4's Patch Apply Rate stays comparable to it without introducing a new sampling difference.

repo_resolution.note: Defaults are conservative (no network calls) since this project's egress policy blocks ad hoc git operations from most environments. Pass --clone-missing/--fetch-missing-commits explicitly on a machine where that is allowed, or prefetch repositories first via scripts/prefetch_swebench_repositories.py.
